URL: https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-903154
Jerusalem Post (21 Jul) + Aju Press (22 Jul) — Iran itself initiated the 10-day ceasefire proposal now advanced by Qatari, Egyptian, Omani, Pakistani mediators, two sources tell JPost. Aim: resolve Strait of Hormuz crisis after MoU collapse. Mediators added "middle corridor" idea between Omani- and Iranian-controlled waters for safe transit. US demanding a LONGER ceasefire + at least partial understanding on freedom of navigation BEFORE any pause takes effect. US official: Trump focused on Iran "pays a price" for MoU violation and deaths of US service members. Neither side has accepted.
